name: Lig do Scíth

tagline.en: O’Domhnaill’s guesthouse in An Cheathrú Rua: bright, spacious rooms, a great breakfast and the best local tips.
tagline.ga: Teach aíochta Uí Dhomhnaill sa Cheathrú Rua: seomraí geala fairsinge, bricfeasta den scoth agus na moltaí áitiúla is fearr.

mapQuery: Lig do Scíth guesthouse, Carraroe, Co. Galway

en: Lig do Scíth, O’Domhnaill’s guesthouse, is in An Cheathrú Rua in the heart of the Connemara Gaeltacht. The name means “take a rest”, and that’s just what guests do.
The rooms are spacious, bright and clean, with comfortable beds and family rooms too. Breakfast gets great reviews, and the owners are full of tips for exploring the area.
There’s free parking and Wi-Fi, a terrace with a barbecue, and the famous Coral Beach is a short trip away.
ga: Tá Lig do Scíth, teach aíochta Uí Dhomhnaill, sa Cheathrú Rua i gcroílár Ghaeltacht Chonamara. Is é sin go díreach a dhéanann aíonna: ligeann siad a scíth.
Tá na seomraí fairsing, geal agus glan, le leapacha compordacha agus seomraí teaghlaigh freisin. Faigheann an bricfeasta léirmheasanna iontacha, agus tá na húinéirí lán le moltaí faoin gceantar.
Tá páirceáil agus Wi-Fi saor in aisce, ardán le beárbaiciú, agus níl an Trá Choiréalach cháiliúil i bhfad uait.
